def main():
    s = input().strip()
    run_lengths = []
    current_length = 1
    for i in range(1, len(s) + 1):
        if i == len(s) or s[i] != s[i - 1]:
            run_lengths.append(current_length)
            current_length = 1
        else:
            current_length += 1
    ans = sum(1 for length in run_lengths if length % 2 == 0)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
